evidence.title: Display trusted Command Incident next action and optional due time in existing read-only Incident Detail
evidence.goal: Fill CAP-CMD-106's explicitly required coordination/next-action read gap in the already implemented local Incident Detail. Reuse existing optional IncidentOverviewOwner, strictly revalidate returned scoped source, label missing actions unknown and never execute a Class-2 action.
outputs: Existing Incident Detail now displays Command-authorized NextAction, optional due time and clear unknown fallback.
Existing synthetic loopback browser exercises authorized next action, full scope denial and no leak for Command-only principal.
Targeted Go unit/security and existing cross-platform Work Queue + Host full suite on exact candidate commit.
acceptance_tests: Authorized Incident owner returned action visible in existing HTML route; HTML XSS payload escaped.
Missing action/due/source remains unknown; due-only/invalid time/oversize/control/invalid UTF8/cross-scope fields abort with no partial source HTML.
Revoked Incident and Commander lacking overview fields cannot read action despite other Incident access.
Real local browser GET validates independent principal visibility under Basic demo, and previous Case/Result navigation remains unchanged.
Work Queue and cross-product Host workflows plus mandatory engineering security gates complete SUCCESS on exact SHA.

rules: Strict tenant isolation and permission checking
